newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC to expand chip lines at Yamagata plant - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: NEC to expand chip lines at Yamagata plant - Kyodo.

text.p: NEC Corp. will resume building new semiconductor production lines at its plant in northeastern Yamagata prefecture, reversing the suspension of construction on expectations of firmer chip prices, Kyodo news agency quoted company officials as saying on Sunday.

NEC would invest about 10 billion yen to build new production lines for application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) to begin operations in the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1998, Kyodo quoted the officials as saying.

NEC, which suspended construction of the new lines last September when chip prices plunged, decided to resume building on expectations of rising demand for integrated circuits for communication equipment and household electrical appliances, the report said.
